purpose: Meshy CC0 candidate kit for the first Orvalis crypt/dungeon review scene. Source pages are provenance records; production assets must be downloaded as GLB and copied locally before use.

assets.label: Stone Dungeon Asset Pack
assets.author: danyatatarin228
assets.usage: Primary modular stone language: walls/floor/architectural mass if the downloaded GLB contains separable usable pieces.
assets.notes: Meshy page marks the model as lowpoly/stylized and CC0. Reject or split pieces that are incoherent or unnecessarily dense.

assets.label: Ossuary Gate
assets.author: jurafjvs
assets.usage: End-of-room landmark / locked progression gate at the back of the crypt.
assets.notes: Gothic stonework, crypt/ossuary tags. Use once as a focal landmark rather than repeating it.

assets.label: Dungeon Stone Floor
assets.author: juho.katsomo
assets.usage: Primary walkable stone floor module; repeat only after checking seams and pivot.
assets.notes: Tagged ground/floor/dungeon/stone/tiles/rough/medieval/fantasy. Normalize to Orvalis scale and flatten accidental underside geometry if present.

assets.label: Ancient Wooden Dungeon Door
assets.author: BlueLog
assets.usage: Side-room door / secondary exit. Prefer one or two instances maximum in the first scene.
assets.notes: Prompt explicitly targets a stylized fantasy modular dungeon door with separate door/frame meshes.

assets.label: Bone Pile
assets.author: Warface
assets.usage: Sparse storytelling prop near walls, coffins and dead ends; never carpet the floor with repeated copies.
assets.notes: Use rotation/scale variation and low density so the scene reads as an old crypt rather than horror clutter.

assets.label: Wooden Coffin
assets.author: johaniashivclaw
assets.usage: Crypt side alcove prop; 2-4 instances with deliberate offsets and orientation changes.
assets.notes: CC0 Meshy 6 model. Keep only if its silhouette/material language survives Orvalis normalization.
